name: Hanging Mobile
description: A balanced mobile of wire arms and paper pieces that turns slowly in the air and stirs when the pointer passes through it.

props.name: items
props.description: The tree to hang. An arm is { left, right }, each side holding a piece or another arm. A piece is { node?, shape?, color?, weight? }: node is any content (it turns up to about 60° and never shows its back), otherwise a paper shape ("disc", "drop", "leaf", "crescent" or "crystal") in color, default a palette colour. weight defaults to 1 and sets both the paper's area and where each arm's thread is tied, so that every arm balances. Keep it to three levels of arms.

props.name: breeze
props.description: How hard the air moves the mobile, from 0 (still air) to 1. At 0 it comes to rest and only the pointer moves it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Moving the pointer through the mobile pushes the arms it passes and sets nearby pieces swinging.

props.name: width
props.description: Largest width in pixels. In a narrower container the whole mobile scales down and keeps its proportions.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in pixels at full width. Arm lengths and threads are fitted to width and height.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for thread lengths, resting angles and the pattern of the breeze.
